name: Sweta: Mourning the Undead
source:
In 2024, a zombie outbreak tears the world apart. A Nepali girl and her older brother try to survive together. 

[From [url=https://tridevi-ishwori.itch.io/sweta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2024年，僵尸爆发，世界四分五裂。一名尼泊尔女孩和她的哥哥一起努力生存。
